$comment: The dependency pins and why each is here (PLAN.md §6.10). Every field and rule: tools/cmd/deps.ts's file comment. Dates are npm's and nodejs.org's, UTC. Change pins through node x deps --update, or an upgrade WP.

three.measurement: PLAN.md §4.7 (2026-10-09), on the platform: the prototype's full stress test passes on r182 (proof hash 68e1f7d1), while r180 draws the WebGPU post filters black and r181.2 fails WebGPU pipeline validation; r186 does not start on Chromium 141. Against r180, r182 changes none of the APIs game code meets (the math classes, the animation classes, material parameters).
three.reason: The renderer: WebGPU, TSL node materials, the post-processing addons, and the math classes the public API re-exports. The most widely known 3D library on the web (Common ground); only gfx/ sees the renderer.

@dimforge/rapier3d-simd-compat.measurement: PLAN.md §4.7 (2026-10-09), on the platform: a restore continues exactly (0 drift, where 0.19.3 drifts 5–13 cm), so captures need no workaround; 4.3 ms a step at 1,000 bodies against 5.1 ms for 0.19.3's SIMD build; the character controller's snap-to-ground fixed. Its API is 0.19's plus optional parameters.
@dimforge/rapier3d-simd-compat.reason: Physics: rigid bodies, colliders, queries and the character controller, deterministic and restorable (Reproducible). The SIMD build, with its WASM inlined; only engine/physics sees its API.

@stdlib/math-base-special-cos.reason: A pure-JS fdlibm cos that the sim swaps into Math while it steps, so Node and Chromium agree bit for bit (§6.5); V8's own cos differs by 1 ulp between them (§4.7).

@stdlib/math-base-special-pow.reason: A pure-JS fdlibm pow that the sim swaps into Math while it steps (§6.5): Node 22's Math.pow differs from Chromium's (§4.7).

@stdlib/math-base-special-sin.reason: A pure-JS fdlibm sin that the sim swaps into Math while it steps, so Node and Chromium agree bit for bit (§6.5); V8's own sin differs by 1 ulp between them (§4.7).

@playwright/test.reason: Browser tests (T2): Playwright Test drives the container's Chromium 141 on WebGPU through executablePath (Verifiable).

@types/node.reason: Types for Node's APIs in the tools and tests. It follows the platform's Node line, so @types/node 25 is skipped with Node 25.

@types/three.measurement: Follows three: these are the pinned three.js's own types, admitted by three's measurement (PLAN.md §4.7).
@types/three.reason: three.js's types: a name the pinned release lacks is a type error (pinned knowledge, I-42).

eslint.reason: Lint (T0), and the doctrine's rule families in tools/eslint/, each message naming the fix.

globals.reason: The browser and Node globals for ESLint's configuration.

prettier.reason: Formats code, data and the generated docs (print width 120); x deps --update writes this file through it.

tsx.reason: Runs the TypeScript tools under plain node: x.js registers it, and eslint.config.js loads the rule families through it.

typescript.reason: The language and the type check (npm run typecheck, the first step of T0).

typescript-eslint.reason: ESLint for TypeScript: the parser and the recommended rules, without type information so T0 stays fast.

vite.reason: The dev server and the build: serves TypeScript and three.js from node_modules to the pages and to Playwright.

vitest.reason: Unit tests (T1) in Node, selected through Vite's module graph.

@types/chai.reason: Pulled in by vitest and @vitest/expect (^5.2.2) for expect's types.

@types/estree.reason: Pulled in by rollup (exactly 1.0.9, under vite), eslint and @es-joy/jsdoccomment, for the syntax tree's types.

@types/json-schema.reason: Pulled in by @eslint/core (^7.0.15), for rule schemas.

@types/stats.js.reason: Pulled in by @types/three (*), for its Stats addon's declarations.

@types/webxr.reason: Pulled in by @types/three (>=0.5.17), for the renderers' XR declarations.

@webgpu/types.reason: WebGPU's API types (navigator.gpu, GPUDevice, GPUTexture…), pulled in by @types/three (*); gfx/ code type-checks against them.

@dimforge/rapier3d-compat.reason: @types/three (~0.12.0) needs it for the declarations of three's RapierPhysics addon only. Never import it: the engine's physics is @dimforge/rapier3d-simd-compat 0.21.0 behind engine/physics, and 0.12 (2024-01-28) is nine lines older.

@tweenjs/tween.js.reason: @types/three (~23.1.3) needs it for an addon's declarations only; never imported.

fflate.reason: @types/three (~0.8.2) needs it for the loaders' declarations only; never imported.

meshoptimizer.reason: @types/three (~0.22.0) needs it for an addon's declarations only; never imported.

node.reason: Runs the tools, the tests and the headless sim. .nvmrc names it; scripts/setup.sh installs it while the container ships 22.22.0. Even lines only: odd lines never get LTS, so Node 25 is skipped (§6.10, rule 6).

chromium.reason: The platform's browser (/opt/pw-browsers/chromium, chromium-1194), WebGPU on SwiftShader; it changes when the environment does (Discovery first). It bounds three.js: r186 needs a WebGPU texture-view feature it lacks (§4.7).
